title.plain_text: UPD-002 — ONYX partner ecosystem evidence materially updated

text: Current official public evidence was re-checked against the benchmark question. The new evidence is capability-level evidence, not effectiveness evidence.
This change supersedes the prior benchmark interpretation that partner capability itself was not established. It does not delete the historical record.
The organizational/legal relationship between YemenSoft and Ultimate Solutions, actual partner adoption, partner-generated pipeline and commercial impact remain unresolved.
